title: export Gen 3 tileset pair
description: MG7 G3D: a tileset pair's metatiles: each one's four 8x8 quarters (top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right) in the flattened art (the over, middle and under planes drawn into one; GEN3_BRIDGE_PLAN §10 E5), its behaviour, and whether it draws anything over sprites.

id.description: The engine's id of a primary and secondary tileset pair.

quarters.description: Per metatile (as in mids), its quarters' ids: page * 1024 + index into the g3image pages g3q.<page>.

over.description: Per metatile: part of it is drawn over sprites (roofs, tree tops).

behaviors.description: Behaviour number -> MB_* name, for the numbers used here.
